slides.mainText: Your anxiety doesn’t look like panic.
slides.subText: It looks like perfectionism, a flawless calendar, and a smile that never drops.
When you are the 'strong friend' who handles everything, the world forgets to check on you. But who holds you when you are holding everything else together?

slides.title: It usually looks like:
items: Treating rest as a reward you have to 'earn'.
Apologizing when you haven't done anything wrong.
A harsh inner critic that never sleeps.
Fear of disappointing others overriding your own needs.

slides.mainText: Survival mode is not a lifestyle.
slides.subText: Just because you can carry it, doesn't mean you should have to.

slides.mainText: You don't have to carry the weight alone.
slides.subText: Therapy is your space to finally drop the armor.
